name: Poached Halibut with Roasted Bok Choy & Acorn Squash in Coconut Broth

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 acorn squash
9 baby bok choy
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Halve each acorn squash lengthwise, trim off the ends, then scoop out the seeds. Cut into ½-inch thick wedges and divide between two baking sheet pans.

Trim the bok choy ends and cut in half lengthwise; add to the baking sheets with the squash. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat, then spread the veggies out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping veggies halfway through, until fork-tender, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, pat the halibut dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a plate; season the top-side with salt and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg halibut fillet
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger, garlic, onion, and chili-garlic sauce; cook, stirring frequently, until starting to soften, about 2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, coconut milk, sugar, and fish sauce to the pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp fish sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place halibut fillets, skin-side down, in the broth. Spoon some of the broth over the tops of the fillets, then cover the pot; poach the fish until opaque and cooked through, about 5 minutes, depending on the thickness of each fillet. Remove from heat.
While the fish is cooking, cut limes into wedges.
Divide roasted veggies, halibut, and coconut broth between bowls. Serve with lime wedges and enjoy!
